exposure: allocating responsibility for VBAC candidates attempting labour to the hospital's three high-risk obstetric consultants
implementing a next birth after caesarean (NBAC) antenatal clinic designed to counsel and support women deciding on mode of birth for their next pregnancy after a primary caesarean section
cohort: 396 women experiencing their first pregnancy following primary caesarean section
finding: A combined strategy of dedicated VBAC clinic and consistent labour management improved overall VBAC rates.
mod_finding: Malpresentation as an indication for previous caesarean section was associated with an increased likelihood of attempted vaginal birth, while East Asian ethnicity was associated with an increased likelihood of choosing repeat caesarean.
